summary: Enroll in our course focused on Measuring Social Impact in Development Projects. Learn to evaluate and improve the outcomes of your development efforts.
lede: Social impact measurement helps development teams assess project outcomes and understand whether initiatives are contributing to change. Designed for NGO project managers, CSR professionals, public-sector leaders, monitoring and evaluation staff, and others involved in development work, the course covers selecting measurement frameworks, creating qualitative and quantitative indicators, and planning data collection. Learners also explore analyzing findings and communicating impact to stakeholders.
audience: CSR professionals in the private sector
Public sector leaders focused on sustainable development
Academics and researchers interested in practical impact
